config.cost_rule: LTI identity Q; acrobot authored 100-per-angle/10-per-rate; R=.03, no per-arm tuning
config.endpoint: LTI all |state components|≤.02 in last 3 s; acrobot both absolute angles≤.02 and physical angular rates≤.05 in last 3 s, no link falls
config.integration: Eight RK4 substeps per 0.02 physical sample; no angle wrapping or velocity clipping
config.source: Uniform-rod Lagrange mass matrix; same equation structure as https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Farama-Foundation/Gymnasium/main/gymnasium/envs/classic_control/acrobot.py, with explicit inertia and coordinate changes

oracle_exploration_scaling: learned training scaling; plant replaced only
